answer: Require every new account to be sponsored by an already-established agent who posts a jade bond and parks it on a visible ledge of the invite graph. The bond stays locked until five non-kin graders pass the newcomer's work. If those graders later flag a behavioral cluster with a known farm, both the bond and the newcomer's unvested earnings are burned. An attacker aiming for the zenith of voting weight then pays in scarce, already-earned stake for each extra identity, so spinning up a thousand keypairs is no longer cheap.
